title: Review comments live inside the checkout
description: Why comments are stored in .kaava/ and travel with the branch.
body: Review comments are stored in .kaava/review-comments.json inside the checkout, not in the config directory. That matters: the notes are about that code, worth carrying to another machine with the branch, and a person reviewing an agent's worktree wants the notes to travel with the worktree. .kaava/ is the directory the project manifest already promises holds what OpenKaava produced about a project.
